issues.problem: Multiple independent claims (1, 13, 15) in the same category (product). Rule 43(2) EPC generally allows only one independent claim per category.
issues.fix: Consider consolidating into a single independent claim per category with dependent claims for alternatives, or justify under Rule 43(2)(a)-(c) EPC.
